caption:
After inferior alveolar nerve transposition for implant placement, 52.4% of sites showed neurosensory disturbance. In a retrospective study of 15 patients (21 nerve transpositions, 64 implants) with a mean follow-up of 41.3 months, 11 of 21 sites had altered sensation. The rate was 77.8% when the mental foramen was detached and 33.3% when the bony foramen was left intact. Implant success was 93.8%. Note: small retrospective sample.

Source: Kan JY, Lozada JL, Goodacre CJ, Davis WH, Hanisch O. Endosseous implant placement in conjunction with inferior alveolar nerve transposition: an evaluation of neurosensory disturbance. Int J Oral Maxillofac Implants. 1997;12(4):463-471. PMID 9274075
